date.as_written: nepālaṃ (!) saṃvat 949 miti āṣāḍha śu di 6 roja 3

notes: The colophon reads NS 949 (= ca. 1829 CE). The catalogue gives 'NS 494', which looks like a transposition of the digits. The late formula ('miti ... roja') and the Devanagari script both fit NS 949 better than NS 494 (ca. 1374 CE). 'kujikātaṃtre' is a corrupt spelling of kubjikātantre (Kubjikātantra). No persons are named.
